discussion: each term page carries a ## Discussion section where discussion-on-term happens; unresolved discussion is recorded there, never silently dropped

frontmatter.term_id: stable slug, unique across term pages; never reused after deprecation

pattern: Protege / WebProtege pattern only (deep-study batch 8, Stanford): typed relations, revision history, discussion-on-term. Protege itself is NOT deployed and no ontology file is imported.

relations.shape: each relation is one line under ## Relations: '- <predicate>: [[target]] - <optional note>'

revision_history: each term page carries a ## Revision history section with at least one dated entry '- YYYY-MM-DD: <change> (<actor>)'; every status or relation change adds an entry
